items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I was the only Dallas boy who was in the band. The rest of them was all from New Orleans.

ctx.x: Were most of the other guys from New Orleans as well?
Yeah. The trombone player and the banjo player and an alto player. I was the only Dallas boy who was in the band. The rest of them was all from New Orleans.
